ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases focus on computer setup and maintenance; I have no clear need for another TV device.
ItemID: NA; Title: SAMSUNG T7 Portable SSD 500GB - Up to 1050MB/s - USB 3.2 External Solid State Drive, Blue (MU-PC500H/AM); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this for portable backups and moving files between my computers.
ItemID: NA; Title: Soundcore Anker Life Q20 Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling Headphones, Wireless Over Ear Bluetooth Headphones, 40H Playtime, Hi-Res Audio, Deep Bass, Memory Foam Ear Cups, for Travel, Home Office; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My headset purchases and under-desk headphone mount make these appealing; I would try them for quieter listening at my desk.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A voice-controlled display does not address a need in my current computer setup.

ItemID: NA; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently looking to build a home security setup.
ItemID: NA; Title: Apple AirPods Pro; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no demonstrated need for Apple-specific earbuds and would prioritize my desk equipment.
ItemID: NA; Title: SanDisk 128GB Ultra MicroSDXC UHS-I Memory Card with Adapter - 100MB/s, C10, U1, Full HD, A1, Micro SD Card - SDSQUAR-128G-GN6MA; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would consider this for more Raspberry Pi storage, after checking compatibility; my Garmin card purchase alone does not establish compatibility.
ItemID: NA; Title: Seagate Exos X18 16TB Enterprise HDD - CMR 3.5 Inch Hyperscale SATA 6Gb/s, 7200 RPM, 512e and 4Kn FastFormat, Low Latency with Enhanced Caching (ST16000NM000J); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no evident need for this much enterprise storage or a suitable drive enclosure.
